**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

Section 18 already meets or exceeds every element of our preferred insurance position:

| Playbook requirement | § 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✓ exactly |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✓ exactly |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (vendor processes Customer Data per § 15) | ✓ exactly |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✓ plus employer's liability USD 1M (extra) |
| Term + 1 year tail | ✓ "throughout the term and for one year afterward" |
| Certificates on request | ✓ § 18.2 |

Section 18.2 also gives us favourable extras beyond the playbook: reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and express confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. The only qualifier ("to the extent available from its insurer" on cancellation notice) is market-standard and not something the playbook requires, so it does not merit a deviation.
